# Endangered Language Alliance

> > The Endangered Language Alliance documents, preserves, and revitalizes Indigenous, minority, and endangered languages spoken in New York City and beyond through community-based collaboration.

Founded in 2010, ELA focuses on linguistic diversity across diaspora communities and Indigenous populations, operating from New York City with support from major funders including the NSF, NEH, and NEA. The organization combines language documentation using specialized linguistic tools with active community revitalization programs.

## About & Mission

- [About](https://www.elalliance.org/about): ELA mission: documenting Indigenous, minority, and endangered languages since 2010
- [How We Work](https://www.elalliance.org/about/how-we-work): ELA's collaborative methodology using language documentation and FLEx tools
- [Supporters](https://www.elalliance.org/about/who-we-are/supporters): List of ELA supporters including NSF, NEH, NEA, and other funding organizations

## Language Documentation

- [Languages](https://www.elalliance.org/languages): Directory of 100+ endangered languages documented by ELA in NYC and beyond
- [Arberesh](https://www.elalliance.org/languages/arberesh): AMAR project documenting Arberesh language of Albanian diaspora in Italy and NYC
- [Amuzgo](https://www.elalliance.org/languages/amuzgo): Documentation of Amuzgo language spoken in Guerrero and Oaxaca, Mexico
- [Bukhori](https://www.elalliance.org/languages/bukhori): Documentation of Bukhori, Iranian language of Central Asian Jewish diaspora
- [Middle Eastern Languages](https://www.elalliance.org/projects/middle-eastern-languages): Project documenting Neo-Aramaic, Neo-Mandaic, Zaza and other Middle Eastern languages

## Revitalization & Community Programs

- [Revitalization](https://www.elalliance.org/our-work/revitalization): ELA's community-based language revitalization programs and linguistic resources
- [New York COVID-19 Diaries](https://www.elalliance.org/our-work/special-projects/new-york-covid-19-diaries): Multilingual pandemic documentation project featuring daily recordings from NYC
